name: What is included in a pool resurfacing estimate in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: Why do some resurfacing quotes include tile, coping, startup, and repairs while others only list the finish?
mainEntity.text: Why do some resurfacing quotes include tile, coping, startup, and repairs while others only list the finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: A resurfacing estimate can vary a lot depending on what the contractor includes. One quote may only cover removal and application of the new finish, while another may include draining, prep, crack repair, tile line work, coping, startup chemicals, and cleanup. In Los Angeles, where many pools need more than just a cosmetic refresh, a narrow quote can hide real project cost. Homeowners should compare estimates line by line and look for exclusions such as plumbing repairs, bond coat application, accessory removal, or startup testing. The best quote is the one that clearly defines the scope and the finish type, not the one with the lowest starting price. Ask whether permits, access issues, and waste disposal are included. A clear written scope reduces change orders and makes it easier to compare contractors fairly.
acceptedAnswer.description: A complete resurfacing estimate may include draining, surface prep, demolition, plaster or aggregate application, tile or coping repairs, startup treatment, and cleanup. Some quotes only cover the finish itself, which makes them look cheaper at first. The scope matters more than the headline price because missing prep or startup work can shorten the finish life.
